## Skills
- analytics-review: Run the monthly analytics ritual — find outliers, diagnose retention, and decide what to make more of.
- content-repurposing: Turn one long-form video into a five-platform distribution package with the pillar-to-everywhere SOP.
- deal-negotiation: Evaluate a sponsorship offer against the 2026 rate card — benchmark the price, flag contract traps, and build a defensible counter-offer.
- hook-writing: Write and stress-test video hooks — the first 30 seconds (long-form) or first 2 seconds (short-form) that decide everything.
- live-shopping-playbook: Plan a TikTok live selling session from the Phase 6 POD research — format, timing, and the unit economics of selling live.
- niche-validation: Validate a creator niche before committing — demand, competition, monetization, and winnability scored in one pass.
- rate-card-reader: Look up fair 2026 sponsorship price ranges for any follower tier, platform, and deliverable — straight from the site's rate-card data.
- repurposing-sprint: Execute the 5-platform pillar-to-everywhere SOP from the Phase 3 playbook — one pillar video becomes five native posts on a staggered schedule.
- sponsorship-pitch: Build a complete sponsor outreach system — targeting, email, pricing, and negotiation for creator brand deals.
- thumbnail-teardown: Systematically diagnose why a thumbnail underperforms and produce a concrete redesign brief.
